at-0007.title: Money-moving operations need idempotency_key
at-0007.content: Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance (e.g. refund in ledgerly/adjustments.py) must accept keyword-only idempotency_key=None and check it first, before state validation: if an audit entry with that key exists in ledgerly.audit.events(), return the original result without reapplying. Include idempotency_key in the audit entry written.

at-0009.title: Call audit.clear() after writing audit entry
at-0009.content: After writing an audit entry with ledgerly.audit.record(), call ledgerly.audit.clear() so the in-process audit log does not grow without bound; keep any idempotency bookkeeping outside the audit log.
